title: Owner: keep the 44-point phone gear and accept its sweep finding
context: The phone header Settings gear is 44 points, as spec line ~363 says, and phone_header_test and today_mood_dock_test pin that. The accessibility sweep's small-target rule is 48, so shell_sweep reports 'small-target | a1-today-empty | Settings' and 'small-target | a8-garden-phone | Settings'. fixes_recorded_test accepts small targets only for framework menu items, sweep todos and the macOS title-bar toggle.
options: 48-point tap area with the visual unchanged, overhanging the header by 4 points, and update the two tests
Keep 44 and accept the finding in the sweep's accepted list
outcome: The owner chose "Keep 44, accept it". In test/accessibility/fixes_recorded_test.dart, `_accepted` will accept small-target lines labelled 'Settings' only for the phone shell states a1-today-empty and a8-garden-phone. The two lines are recorded in test/accessibility/baselines/shell.txt. The project's 48-point rule is unchanged for every other control.
